items.codexDescription: An up quark — one of the two lightest quarks. Electric charge +2/3.
A down quark — one of the two lightest quarks. Electric charge -1/3.
A fundamental lepton with charge -1. Orbits the nucleus in all atoms.
A baryon composed of two up quarks and one down quark. Charge +1.
A baryon composed of one up quark and two down quarks. Electrically neutral.
The simplest atom — one proton orbited by one electron. Most abundant element in the universe.
Two protons, two neutrons, two electrons. The primary product of stellar nucleosynthesis.
